title: Introduction to `splicelogic`
text: splicelogic R/Bioconductor package detecting alternative splicing events exon-level data stored GRanges objects. Given set exons annotated coefficient column indicating differential transcript usage (positDTU), splicelogic identifies following types splicing events: Skipped exons (SE) – exons present one isoform absent another. Mutually exclusive exons (MXE) – pairs exons one included expense . Retained introns (RI) – intronic regions retained part exon alternative isoform. Alternative 3’ (A3SS) – exons share 5’ splice site differ 3’ end. Alternative 5’ (A5SS) – exons share 3’ splice site differ 5’ end.

title: Introduction to `splicelogic`
text: splicelogic operates GRanges objects contain exon-level annotations. range represents one exon must carry following metadata columns: coefficient input coef_col indicates differential transcript usage (DTU) specific transcript containing exon. exons transcript share coefficient value. values comes prior differential transcript usage analysis, performed satuRn. Positive coefficient values indicate upregulated exons negative values indicate downregulated exons.

title: Introduction to `splicelogic`
text: calc_skipped_exons() identifies exons present downregulated transcripts absent (skipped) upregulated ones. Using gr object generated create_mock_data(), can generate skiped exon events generate_skipped_exons() function, modifies input GRanges object include skipped exon events. can run detection function calc_skipped_exons() modified GRanges object:  result GRanges object containing exons flagged skipped, event column set "skipped_exon". "tx_id" refers transcript includes skipped exon, "tx_event" indicates transcripts respect exon skipped (.e. downregulated transcripts include exon).
code: gr_se <- generate_skipped_exons(gr, n_se = 2) slPltRanges(gr_se) gr_se <- preprocess_input(gr_se, coef_col = "coefs")  se_result <- calc_skipped_exons(gr_se, coef_col = "coefs") se_result ## GRanges object with 5 ranges and 11 metadata columns: ##       seqnames    ranges strand |   gene_id     tx_id exon_rank     coefs ##          <Rle> <IRanges>  <Rle> | <integer> <numeric> <integer> <numeric> ##   [1]    chr13     31-35      + |         1         1         4 -0.235204 ##   [2]    chr13     31-35      + |         1         3         4 -0.685583 ##   [3]    chr13     31-35      + |         1         4         4 -0.985201 ##   [4]    chr13   141-145      + |         2         5         5 -0.682818 ##   [5]    chr13   141-145      + |         2         7         5 -0.420466 ##               key    nexons  internal overlap_count n_txp_pos        event ##       <character> <integer> <logical>     <integer> <integer>  <character> ##   [1]         1-4         6      TRUE             0         1 skipped_exon ##   [2]         3-4         6      TRUE             0         1 skipped_exon ##   [3]         4-4         6      TRUE             0         1 skipped_exon ##   [4]         5-5         6      TRUE             1         2 skipped_exon ##   [5]         7-5         6      TRUE             1         2 skipped_exon ##        tx_event ##       <numeric> ##   [1]         2 ##   [2]         2 ##   [3]         2 ##   [4]         8 ##   [5]         8 ##   ------- ##   seqinfo: 1 sequence from an unspecified genome; no seqlengths mcols(se_result)[, c("gene_id", "tx_id", "n_txp", "event", "tx_event")]

title: Introduction to `splicelogic`
text: calc_mutually_exclusive() detects pairs exons one exon included one isoform different exon occupies equivalent position another isoform. mx_mock_data() dataset designed contain mutually exclusive exon events:
code: gr_mx <- mx_mock_data() gr_mx <- preprocess_input(gr_mx, coef_col = "coefs") mx_result <- calc_mutually_exclusive(gr_mx, coef_col = "coefs") mx_result mcols(mx_result)[, c("gene_id", "tx_id", "exon_rank", "event")]

title: Introduction to `splicelogic`
text: calc_retained_introns() finds exons upregulated transcripts overlap intronic regions downregulated transcripts, indicating intron retention.
code: gr_ri <- create_mock_data(3, 6, 3) gr_ri <- preprocess_input(gr_ri, coef_col = "coefs") gr_ri <- generate_retained_introns(gr_ri, n_ri = 3) ri_result <- calc_retained_introns(gr_ri, coef_col = "coefs") ri_result if (length(ri_result) > 0) {     mcols(ri_result)[, c("gene_id", "tx_id", "exon_rank", "event")] }

title: Introduction to `splicelogic`
text: calc_a3ss_a5ss() detects exons share one boundary (start end) exon another isoform differ opposite end, indicating alternative splice site usage.
code: gr_ss <- create_mock_data(3, 3, 6) gr_ss <- preprocess_input(gr_ss, coef_col = "coefs") gr_ss <- generate_a3ss(gr_ss, n_a3ss = 3) ss_result <- calc_a3ss_a5ss(gr_ss, coef_col = "coefs") ss_result if (length(ss_result) > 0) {     mcols(ss_result)[, c("gene_id", "tx_id", "exon_rank", "event")] }
